activity.notes: Following the Austro-Hungarian Compromise, Franz Joseph was crowned King of Hungary in Budapest on 8 June 1867 and remained king until his death in 1916. ATLAS records the Hungarian crown separately from his Austrian imperial title.

sources.title: Franz Joseph I — Die Welt der Habsburger
sources.citation_text: The Habsburg history portal records Franz Joseph I as Emperor of Austria and King of Hungary, ruling from 1848 to 1916, and states that he ascended the Austrian throne in 1848 and accepted the 1867 Dual Monarchy settlement.
